title: Sparring
integrity: Your opponent uses a chess engine, but does not always pick the first line. Among several sound moves, it prefers lines that ask you to practice what you need most.
targetedBody: Play without assistance. Your opponent will look for the most challenging continuation that is still a sound move.
whySelectedBody: Priority pattern: check forcing replies from your opponent before you commit.
activeSession: You have an active sparring session.
hintBody: Review checks, captures, and threats first. Then imagine your opponent's strongest reply.
noEval: Engine evaluation is hidden during the game.
loadError: Could not load sparring. Check that the engine service is running.
enginePaused: Engine unavailable. You can retry when it is back.

review.title: Post-game review
review.missedForcingReply: A forcing reply was possible here.
review.unverified: Engine could not verify this move.

recommend.forcingReply: Next sessions will prioritize defenses against forcing captures because this resource appeared often and evidence of mastery is still limited.
recommend.continue: Keep sparring with balanced pressure on your priority pattern.

errors.sparring_pattern_unknown: That practice pattern is not available.
errors.sparring_pattern_incompatible_mode: That pattern cannot be used in this mode.
errors.sparring_client_snapshot_forbidden: Practice settings must be chosen in the app, not sent manually.
